title: Configure environment variables for an Input Method Framework
summary: Set the necessary environment variables so your desktop environment correctly uses the installed Input Method Framework (like IBus or Fcitx5) for handling input.

aliases.text: почему не работает ввод на китайском

prerequisites: An Input Method Framework (like IBus or Fcitx5) is installed.

steps.explain:
Add the following lines to your environment configuration file (e.g., ~/.bashrc or /etc/environment):
GTK_IM_MODULE=ibus
QT_IM_MODULE=ibus
XMODIFIERS=@im=ibus

Add the following lines to your environment configuration file:
GTK_IM_MODULE=fcitx
QT_IM_MODULE=fcitx
XMODIFIERS=@im=fcitx

Add the following lines to your environment configuration file:
GTK_IM_MODULE=uim
QT_IM_MODULE=uim
XMODIFIERS=@im=uim

rollback.explain: Remove the added lines from your environment configuration file.

warnings: Incorrectly setting these variables can prevent input methods from working or cause unexpected behavior in applications.
